messages:
Ava: draft release notes ready for review - includes adaptive routing, console rollout tweaks, and a small migration guide for pinned models.
Diego: i'll check the python and curl snippets for breaking changes. any PR link?
Ava: PR is at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4872 on branch release/adaptive-routing-2024.
Nina: taking TS and Go snippets. note: fallback policy param changed shape; will update examples to use object form.
Diego: found one broken anchor in migration guide (#pin-models). i'll push a redirect anchor to the PR.
doc-bot: New comment on PR #4872: "Staging preview deployed. Please verify snippet rendering."
Ava: can someone add a Known Issues one-liner with repro steps for p99 spikes under mixed sequence lengths? keep it short.
Nina: added repro steps to PR comments: stage runtime, send a long context then N parallel shorts, observe p99 spike.
Diego: fixed python example to show fallback_policy as dict and swapped raw github links for permalinks.
Ava: aiming to merge by EOD tomorrow. please add approvals once QA is green.
Nina: approved after QA check.
Diego: approved pending one more quick look on staging metrics.
Ava: thanks all, i'll schedule the docs publish and the Slack announcement after merge.
